methodology: UN Comtrade public preview API (HS 8542 / 8486, 2023). Taiwan bilateral rows often empty — MOF / U.S. Census overrides documented per flow. Re-run: node scripts/fetch-comtrade-trade.mjs --write

flows.notes: Comtrade preview has no TW→US HS8542 rows; value ≈ U.S. imports of HTS 8542 from Taiwan (2023), per Census foreign-trade / industry trade summaries.
Samsung / SK hynix memory exports; verify DRAM/NAND HS codes. Comtrade preview API, trade-kr-us-memory-2023 (410 X → 842 8542) [US import mirror], pulled 2026-05-27.
Includes assembled modules and some domestic chips; control-sensitive categories. Comtrade preview API, trade-cn-us-ics-2023 (156 X → 842 8542) [US import mirror], pulled 2026-05-27.
WFE and related equipment subject to export controls; verify HS 8486 series. Comtrade preview API, trade-us-cn-equipment-2023 (842 X → 156 8486), pulled 2026-05-27.
ASML systems; EU/export-license constrained. Cross-check ASML China revenue disclosures. Comtrade preview API, trade-nl-cn-equipment-2023 (528 X → 156 8486), pulled 2026-05-27.
Korea memory into China assembly ecosystem (e.g. Wuxi packaging). Comtrade preview API, trade-kr-cn-memory-2023 (410 X → 156 8542), pulled 2026-05-27.
Comtrade preview has no TW→CN HS8542 rows; estimate ≈ Taiwan IC exports (MOF 2023, US$166.6B) × ~55% to mainland China/Hong Kong (USTBC semiconductor trade report pattern).
Comtrade preview has no US→TW HS8486 rows; order-of-magnitude from Taiwan imports from U.S. (CBC 2023, US$40.7B) and machinery/equipment share (USITC Taiwan trade overview).
